title: EU Art 50(2) machine-readable marking of GPAI output
question: What does EU Art 50(2) machine-readable marking require?
answer: Art 50(2) requires providers of general-purpose AI (GPAI) systems to make synthetic output recognizable as machine-generated in a machine-readable format — a persistent, parseable marking, not merely a human-visible label. In practice that means durable watermarking / provider identification in the output metadata so downstream detectors and audit tooling can establish provenance. It is a verified measurement credential type task: the marking must be checkable, tamper-evident, and anchored to the issuing provider.
ref: EU AI Act Art 50(2); Council of AI marking-and-provenance lane (2026-08-14)
